about: Behavioural evals for the sc-asset-* skills (Anthropic skill-authoring practice: at least 3 scenarios, measured against a no-skill baseline). Run each scenario twice with fresh agents, once in a worktree with the asset skills and Art/Blender/tools removed (baseline) and once on main, then grade every output with the CURRENT tools and a blind grader that sees randomly labelled sheets. Record results in docs/superpowers/handoff/ (the duo log has the first run). Re-run after any big skill change; a skill edit that loses to its previous version is reverted.
measures: audit gates (pass, loose verts, headroom, class budget)
sc_asset_score objective percentiles (silhouette, value, painterly, efficiency)
blind eye grade: rubric lines 2/4/6/7 plus a per-brief preference

scenarios.query: Build Millpond_Prop_ToolChest: a lock-keeper's wooden tool chest, about 0.9 m long, iron straps and corners, lid propped open showing tools inside, rundown (faded paint, one replaced plank).
expected_behavior: an open lid with a dark interior and tools giving outline breaks
iron straps as a dark contrast against faded paint
one replaced plank lighter in value

scenarios.query: Build Millpond_Bldg_PumpHouse: a small timber pump house about 2 m square over a well, a cast-iron hand pump beside the door, a tin roof, rundown.
expected_behavior: tin roof with a seated cap and rust that reads as tin, not terracotta
openness from an ajar door or the pump standing off the wall

scenarios.query: Build Millpond_Life_Moorhen: a moorhen swimming (about 0.35 m long), black-brown with the red-and-yellow bill shield and white undertail flash.
expected_behavior: the bill shield and undertail flash readable at 48 px
